proposals.evidence: DEDR848 directly gives Malto éṛu ‘good, beautiful, in health’ and identifies its old DED number as 722. The source quoted that old number; current DEDR722 is instead a pungency family. Survey hēḍu is a comparative Malto variant with initial h and retroflex stop notation retained, and the existing parent’s uncertain reconstruction is not upgraded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
